Signed BGB 1591 record-based maternity prerequisite merged in PR #54 after source/excerpt, actual query-day, shared candidate-child test and repository CI checks. This does not compute the remaining qualifying-child or claimant-entitlement rules.

Signed BGB187 first-counted-day prerequisites merged in PR #59 after verbatim source, supported observation scope, six-row date-boundary tests and green repository CI. Three observable Date leaves supply the event, beginning-of-day and birth records; these helpers do not decide the applicable regime, calculate deadline ends or establish full legal ages.

Signed EStG78 record and receipt-month prerequisites, accepted only after verbatim source, complete companion fixtures, independent record cases and green repository CI. The reference-period and receipt-cutoff helpers do not establish the full preserved priority or same-child credit; the two explicit section64 dependencies and continuing residence, child qualification, territory and office-competence conditions remain unimplemented.

Complete EStG32(3) birth/month/age criterion from two observable birth-register facts, age18parameter and BGB187/188calendar proofs. Other child criteria, relationships, adult-child routes and count remain unencoded; not full EStG32/63 entitlement.

Complete Article59 change-month continuation, notice duty and first-successor-month takeover from identified issued coordination and original payment records. National entitlement, EU personal/material scope, Article68priority/differential and treaty overrides remain unencoded. Calendar helpers only apply with their respective original-payer or successor applicability judgments.
